'''Secure Storage''' was a sector of the [[Maximum Security Section]] of [[Belsavis prison]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Secure Storage was a walled-off section of the prison with a subterranean vault underneath [[Meltwater Pond]] to the north, and was located in the southeastern corner of Maximum Security. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], the western wall was breached, and the area overrun by prisoners.<ref name="TOR" />
